decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template is low-cost and tied to the core shop hosting business, so with growing turnover and available slack there is no shortfall forcing a drop, though its fading web presence makes a quiet phase-out plausible.
The responsive template costs little and supports CMS hosting customers, so it does not fall below aspiration enough to trigger problemistic search, even though it has little visibility.
Premium support directly reinforces the firm's core differentiator of expert round-the-clock agency support and likely brings recurring revenue above aspiration.
The version management tool builds on the platform and reduces recurring operational work for agencies, which fits the stated strategy and justifies continued investment.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship of the firm's strategic direction and sits close to its core competencies, so it clearly meets aspiration levels and will be kept.
